name: sSup_of_countable_affine_eq
statement: IsClosed s) (hφc : LowerSemicontinuousOn φ s) (hφcv : ConvexOn ℝ s φ) : ∃ 𝓕' : Set (s → ℝ), 𝓕'.Countable ∧ sSup 𝓕' = s.restrict φ ∧ ∀ f ∈ 𝓕', f ≤ s.restrict φ ∧ ∃ (l : E →L[𝕜] 𝕜) (c : ℝ), f = s.restrict (re ∘ l) + const s c
